# `public/vendor/character-forge`

Vendored Character Forge builds live here, one directory per version. `current-v2.json` is the default runtime pin (`version`, `generatorVersion`). `current.json` is the v1 fallback pin and is not replaced by a 2.x sync.

Nothing in the version directories is hand-edited. `tools/sync-character-bundle.mjs` is the only writer (`npm run sync:cf -- <CF_DIST>`). A 1.x dist updates `current.json`. A 2.x dist writes `current-v2.json` and leaves the v1 pin alone. 1.2.0 stays on disk. 1.2.1 is the ESM build for Three r187 and the runtime behind `?cf=1` (also the fallback if 2.2.1 fails to init or preload). 2.2.1 is Character Forge api 2 and the runtime the game loads when `?cf=` is absent (`?cf=2` still selects it). Its default locomotion is full-body Quaternius Idle, Walk, and Run. A private build sets `VITE_CF_PRIVATE_ANIM_URL` to use the Kevin Iglesias pack instead; that pack is not in this tree. The game profile is `content/characters/trailbound.json`. `src/render/characters/backends/v1.ts` and `backends/v2.ts` are the runtime callers. `src/render/characters/forge.ts` is the game-facing seam.
